description: Welcome to Sacramento living at its best! New 50 year roof (4/2026 ~ PRC Roofing). This charming 3 bedroom, 1.5 bath home is located in the desirable Sky Pkwy neighborhood and offers the perfect blend of comfort, functionality, and outdoor living. Situated on a huge lot, the property features a gorgeous backyard complete with a covered patio, ideal for entertaining, relaxing, or enjoying year-round outdoor living. Inside, you'll love the great floor plan designed for both everyday living and hosting guests. The beautiful Granite Transformation Kitchen showcases granite countertops, ample cabinetry, and plenty of workspace for cooking and gathering. The spacious bedrooms and well-appointed bathrooms provide comfort and convenience throughout the home. The garage has hardwood ceilings with cabinets suitable for storage and epoxy flooring.Conveniently located close to freeway access, shopping, parks, and schools, this home offers both tranquility and accessibility in one of the area's most desirable neighborhoods. Don't miss this fantastic opportunity to own a beautiful home in a prime location!
